Zapdos

Electric Flying

Kanto · Generation 1 · Legendary Pokémon

Zapdos is an Electric/Flying-type Electric Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 1.6 m tall and weighs 52.6 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (125), with a base stat total of 580.
